concept.title: What is Minecraft?
concept.shortdesc: Minecraft is a sandbox game about placing blocks, exploring, and surviving in procedurally generated worlds.

conbody.p: Minecraft drops you into a blocky world made of voxels. You mine resources, craft tools, build structures, and can choose how much danger you want from hostile creatures.

section.title: Two common editions

ul.li: Java Edition runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It has the largest mod ecosystem and receives snapshots for upcoming features.
Bedrock Edition runs on consoles, mobile devices, and Windows (often via the Microsoft Store). It supports cross-play on supported platforms.

section.p: Pick the edition you own or that matches your devices. The core loop—break blocks, collect drops, craft, build—is the same idea on both.

dlentry.dd: You manage health, hunger, and inventory. Hostile mobs appear at night unless you sleep or stay well lit.
Unlimited blocks, flight, and no survival pressure—ideal for building experiments.
Survival mechanics without hostile mob spawns (you can still take environmental damage in some situations).
